title: RoutineStep — mcp
description: Deterministic MCP tool call. The server is resolved the way a chat opened in the routine's cwd would resolve it (Settings → MCP servers), connected for the step and closed after. Args are validated against the tool's input schema from tools/list before the call.

server.description: MCP server name as NeoPi's discovery reports it for the routine's cwd. The Integrations page lists enabled servers and their tools.

tool.description: Tool name as advertised by the server's tools/list.

args.description: Tool arguments. Templated. Validated against the tool's input schema at runtime.
